mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Companies: the YC company directory (all ~6,000 YC startups), filtered by batch, industry, region, status, tags and more. Jobs: open jobs at YC startups by role (and location), from specific companies, or from all hiring companies that match the company filters.

query.title: Search
query.description: Optional free-text search over company names, one-liners and descriptions, e.g. payments or AI agents. Leave empty to list every company that matches the filters.

batches.title: Batches
batches.description: YC batches, e.g. Summer 2025, Winter 2024, Spring 2026, Fall 2025. Short codes work too: S25, W24, X26 (Spring), F25 (Fall). Leave empty for all batches.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Industries or sub-industries as on ycombinator.com/companies, e.g. B2B, Fintech, Healthcare, Engineering, Product and Design, Security. A company matches if it has any of them.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Company regions or countries, e.g. United States of America, Europe, India, Latin America, Remote, Fully Remote. A company matches if it has any of them.

statuses.title: Status
statuses.description: Only companies with any of these statuses. Leave empty for all.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Company tags, e.g. Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, SaaS, Open Source, Robotics. A company matches if it has any of them.

hiringOnly.title: Only companies that are hiring
hiringOnly.description: Only companies with open jobs on YC's job board.

topCompaniesOnly.title: Only YC top companies
topCompaniesOnly.description: Only companies on YC's Top Companies list.

minTeamSize.title: Min team size
minTeamSize.description: Only companies with at least this many employees.

maxTeamSize.title: Max team size
maxTeamSize.description: Only companies with at most this many employees.

sortBy.title: Sort companies by
sortBy.description: Relevance: YC's default directory order. Launch date: newest launched companies first (ignored when Search is set).

jobRoles.title: Job roles
jobRoles.description: Jobs mode: YC job board roles. Each role reads ycombinator.com/jobs/role/<role> (in the job location below, if set). Leave empty to use only company jobs pages, or all roles in the job location.

jobLocation.title: Job location
jobLocation.description: Jobs mode: optional location for the role pages, e.g. remote, san-francisco, new-york, los-angeles, seattle, boston, austin, london, india. Leave empty for all locations.

companySlugs.title: Companies
companySlugs.description: Jobs mode: YC company slugs or URLs, e.g. stripe or https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb. Reads each company's jobs page.

jobsFromFilteredCompanies.title: Jobs at companies matching the company filters
jobsFromFilteredCompanies.description: Jobs mode: also read the jobs page of every hiring company that matches the company filters above (batch, industry, region, tags, ...), e.g. all open jobs at Summer 2025 startups. One page request per company.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many companies (Companies mode) or jobs (Jobs mode). Each item is billed as one event.

onlyNew.title: Only new items (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only companies or jobs not returned by an earlier run with the same mode and filters. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-company or new-job alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new items. State is kept in the key-value store "ycombinator-companies-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy for ycombinator.com pages (usually not needed). The company search itself uses YC's public search API directly.
